text:
Priya Nair: Quick sync — draft of the launch post is ready for review. Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/LAUNCH_DRAFT. Want to align messaging with the webinar headline + benchmark numbers. Can folks take a look by EOD?

Alex Chen: On it, will check hero copy + CTAs. Do we have final benchmark numbers? Last week I remember ~35% latency improvement vs baseline.

Priya Nair: Updated numbers in the doc — please use 38% p95 latency reduction and 2.3x throughput on A100 in the Benchmarks section (I put the test summary at the end).

Jon Rutherford: Quick legal FYI — avoid absolute comparative claims w/o source. Please add a parenthetical: (internal Redwood benchmark; test details in appendix).

Eli Ortiz: Also adding webinar registrant CTA: "See it in action — join our webinar" with HubSpot form id: 12345. @Sam (Growth) can you map that to the campaign UTM params?

Sam (Growth): Yep. Proposed UTMs: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch_q2. I'll create a HubSpot form named "Launch Webinar — Blog" and map fields for company size + primary use case.

DesignBot: Uploaded hero image variants to /assets/launch/hero-variants-v3.png. Recommend variant C for dark header (preview attached in doc).

Alex Chen: Small copy tweak suggestion — change "2.3x throughput" to "up to 2.3x throughput" to be safe.

Priya Nair: Good catch — updated the line and added a short "how we measured" bullet linking to the eval repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals (see doc end).

Jon Rutherford: Legal signs off on the "up to 2.3x" phrasing and the parenthetical source. ✅

Priya Nair: Awesome. Next: publish checklist — need final hero image, legal ok (done), UX QA, HubSpot form live, webinar page linked, social snippets. I assigned owners in the doc.

Sam (Growth): HubSpot form will be live by tomorrow 11am PT. I'll paste the embed code here once it's live. :white_check_mark:

Eli Ortiz: Webinar landing page is up at https://redwood.ai/webinars/launch-demo. Registration box added, just waiting for the embed.

Sam (Growth): Embed code (copy/paste): <iframe src="https://share.hsforms.com/12345" width="100%" height="600"></iframe>

Priya Nair: Perfect — last ask: @Alex Chen @DesignBot can you run a quick mobile sanity on hero + form? Want to avoid clipping on smaller screens (iPhone SE).

Alex Chen: Will test on iPhone 12 + SE in BrowserStack and report back within an hour.

DesignBot: Swapped image crop for variant C and reduced focal-left, should be safe for narrow viewports.

Priya Nair: Thanks everyone. If no further comments, I'll schedule publish for Tue 9am PT and webinar for Wed 10am PT. :rocket: 

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled — publish job queued for 2026-03-24T16:00:00Z.

Sam (Growth): FYI — I've also added UTM tracking in HubSpot campaign dashboard. Will share performance view post-launch.

Priya Nair: Great — closing thread unless anything urgent pops up. Thanks all! :pray:
